Ana de Armas

Ana de Armas
Born30 April 1988
OccupationActress
Years active2006-present

Ana Celia de Armas Caso is a Cuban and Spanish actress. She began her career in Cuba and later moved to Spain, then to Hollywood.

She is known for roles in Blade Runner 2049, Knives Out, No Time to Die, and Blonde. This fixture is a reduced static snapshot for CI; it is not a live Wikipedia page.
